skills.skill: Divide a three-digit number by a two-digit number, giving the quotient and remainder

misconceptions.pattern: Reports the quotient but drops the remainder (gives remainder 0 when there is a real remainder), or lets the remainder reach or exceed the two-digit divisor.

strategies.intent: Estimate how many whole divisors fit (round the divisor to the nearest ten to guess the quotient), multiply back, then take the difference from the dividend as the remainder — which must be smaller than the divisor.
